Hi Mina / team,

Thanks for taking this on. Nova Payments has confirmed they need a fully auditable chain-of-custody for the April release bundle. High level asks from Nova: 1) signed manifest for every media unit (USB/SSD) with SHA256 checksums, 2) a pre-authorized list of on-site custodians who can accept and sign, and 3) a tamper-evident packaging and shipping window (preferred: 2027-04-18 to 2027-04-20).

Can Redwood provide the standard custody template and spell out the signing workflow? Also confirm whether Redwood requires any transport-level sealing (serial-numbered seals) or if our standard tamper-evident pouch is sufficient.

Subject: Re: Physical media chain-of-custody for air-gapped updates — custody & transport plan

Dana / Ben — thanks for the details. Draft proposal below (please review):

Summary (what Redwood will provide)
- Signed manifest per physical media unit (CSV + PDF) listing image_id, build_hash (SHA256), media_serial, assigned_seal_id, ship_date, and recipient_custodian.
- HSM-backed image signing (we will provide a signed_image_manifest.pdf that includes signature metadata and timestamp).
- Tamper-evident packaging with serialized seals. SecureLogistics to retain seals until handoff.
- Two-person acceptance at recipient site: on-site custodian (pre-approved) + carrier representative sign-off.

Proposed workflow (roles & steps)
1) Redwood prepares image artifacts and generates CSV manifest (attached: custody_manifest_template.csv).
2) Security signs manifests and stamps a timestamped PDF (signed_image_manifest.pdf).
3) Physical media staged in locked room; carrier picks up with chain-of-custody form filled by SecureLogistics.
4) At delivery, recipient checks seal id, verifies SHA256 against manifest, signs both carrier and Redwood copies. Photograph required for audit.
5) Scanned/photographed acceptance uploaded to our secure Drive link within 24h of delivery.

Open items for decision
- Seal type: we prefer serialized bolt seals vs adhesive tamper tapes for higher assurance. Security ops: any objections?
- On-site custodian vetting: Ben, please confirm the list of pre-authorized custodians and their contact details.
- DocuSign vs in-person wet signature: we will require an in-person signature for the primary acceptance; DocuSign can be used for secondary acknowledgement.

Attachments: custody_manifest_template.csv, physical_transport_sop.txt (draft), signed_image_manifest_demo.pdf (sample).

Action items
- Dana: confirm carrier seal handling and propose pickup window.
- Ben: provide custodians list by 2027-04-14.
- Vivek/Neha/Dev: review SOP for automation gaps.

Thanks — Ill stand up a short call if needed.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Mina — this looks good. A few quick edits/calls-to-action from infra/ops perspective: 

Inline notes:
> 1) Redwood prepares image artifacts and generates CSV manifest
- We should include an explicit field for artifact_builder_id and CI build URL (immutable) so we can trace root-of-trust.

> 2) Security signs manifests and stamps a timestamped PDF
- Confirm signing key rotation window. If the signing key rotates between staging and shipment, include both signatures or a chain record.

> 3) Physical media staged in locked room
- Suggest adding tamper-evidence photo before sealing and a random 2% checksum re-verify after 24 hours to detect pre-shipment corruption.

> Seal type: prefer serialized bolt seals vs adhesive tapes
- Agreed. SecureLogistics: can you confirm availability of serialized seals and whether they log seal-supplier batch numbers?

> DocuSign vs in-person wet signature
- For the primary acceptance we must have wet signature + photo. Dev: can you automate the manifest checksum verification at acceptance and post the verification report to the Drive link?

Action owners assigned:
- neha_kapoor: add audit-fields (signing_key_id, signer_certificate_fingerprint) to the manifest and confirm retention policy for 7 years.
- dev_patel: build a simple checksum verifier script and pre-seed a verification mailbox for acceptance uploads (ETA EOD 2027-04-15).
- viva: Mina, please confirm if Redwood legal needs to sign a shipping addendum.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min triage call if we need to finalize before Bens custodians list.

- Vivek
SVP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
